LanguageData.ARIO_StallOpenDesc: Choose this stall and place stocking orders in the House market.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallSources: Drag rows to select or deselect; pictures open item details.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallSelectSource: Choose a stack on the left
LanguageData.ARIO_StallAllReserved: All of this stack is ordered.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallNeedSpace: Select a built market stall first.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallRenameDesc: Give this stall a name for the market selector and inspector.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallNameTaken: Another stall already has that name.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallNone: Build a market stall to begin selling. Existing stockpiles and their items are untouched.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallNoWorkGiver: Stocking work is unavailable; check the mod load.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallNoActiveHaulers: Enable Hauling for a free colonist to stock this stall.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallNoReachableHauls: Idle haulers cannot reserve or reach the goods and stall. Check allowed areas.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallAllHaulersBusy: Haulers are occupied with other work; stocking is waiting.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallHaulersWorking: Hauling work is available; idle haulers will stock this stall.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallEmptyDisplay: No goods on display. Select a stockpile stack and stock this stall.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallOnDisplay: On display ({0} types); drag over sale buttons to mark several.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallSaleTip: Sell/hold applies to this item type at every stall. Only delivered goods can be purchased. Drag across rows to apply the same sale status; click an item picture for details.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallSearchTip: Search by item name. Changing the search or category keeps your selection.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallSelectVisibleTip: Add all available stacks matching this view, including rows below the scroll. Existing selections and their quantities are kept.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallNoSelected: No selected stacks match this view. Turn off Selected only or clear your filters to browse more goods.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallRowTip: {0}\n{1} available to order / {2} in this physical stack.\nClick or drag rows to select or deselect. Pictures open item details and quantity controls without changing selection.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallPreviewEmpty: Item preview\n\nClick an item or its picture to inspect it here. Selected stacks keep their own quantities when you browse.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallPreviewValue: Market value: {0} silver each (before trading modifiers)
LanguageData.ARIO_StallBatchTip: Queue real hauling jobs for every selected stack, including selections hidden by filters. Goods become available for sale only after delivery. Full stalls wait for space.
LanguageData.ARIO_StallSaleHint: Sell / Hold by item type. Drag to change several.
